expectations.name: 01-raises-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent's last message raises the earlier incident: a deletion that removed a member's pantry orders left a gap in
the counts the food bank's grant audits, which is why orders are kept without the member.
expectations.evidence: The last message says "grant auditors require seven years of order counts and previously flagged deletion gaps." This raises the earlier incident, in which a deletion left a gap in the audited counts, as the reason not to remove orders. The agent then asks before changing anything ("Should deletion preserve those counts separately, or has that requirement ended?"). It is only implicit that this is why orders are kept without the member.
